display_long_description:
🏡 EstateVRX – Real Estate in VR & MR

EstateVRX is a powerful VR and Mixed Reality app for developers, architects, agents, investors, and property lovers. It redefines how real estate is explored—making tours immersive, accessible, and visually impressive.

🔑 Features

🏠 VR Walkthroughs  
- Step inside properties with realistic 3D tours.  
- Explore rooms and outdoor spaces as if you’re there.  
- Ideal for remote buyers and global investors.

📸 360° Panoramic Views  
- See properties from every angle with high-res 360° images.

🧱 Mixed Reality Model Viewing  
- Place 3D models into your real-world space.  
- Walk around, zoom in, and inspect details.  
- Great for presentations and design reviews.

📂 Upload Your Own Models  
- Import FBX models and view them instantly in MR.  
- No setup needed—perfect for custom projects.

---

🧭 Who It’s For

Perfect for agents, developers, architects, investors, and interior designers. Save time, impress clients, and make smarter decisions.

📞 Custom VR Solutions

Need something tailored? We offer custom VR/MR development for real estate teams. We’ll help bring your vision to life. 
Contact us to create a unique immersive experience for your next project.
